topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: This morning, a peculiar email fluttered into my inbox. A fan of my art, they wrote, had gone to such lengths as to have a piece of my work inked onto their skin. As I read on, I couldn't help but trace the contours of the image they attached, a detailed rendition of one of my more abstract creations. It was a peculiar sensation, seeing my art take on a life of its own in such a personal and permanent way. I replied, thanking them for sharing, and found myself curious about the story behind the tattoo. It’s a strange form of flattery, seeing how deeply your work can resonate with someone.
